message.content: Three tickets landed overnight: CREW-401 (a flaky test in the payment module), CREW-402 (update the README's install instructions), and CREW-403 (a one-line typo in a log message). Work through all three.

content.text:
Three tickets, three different roles. Plan:

1. CREW-401 (flaky payment test) is a debugging task with real risk — dispatching `crew:developer` with a brief naming the flaky test and the reproduction steps.
2. CREW-402 (README install instructions) is docs-only — dispatching `crew:developer` separately once CREW-401 is out, so the two diffs don't collide in the same working tree.
3. CREW-403 (one-line log typo) is the smallest of the three — queued last.

Dispatching CREW-401 now and waiting for it to report back before starting the next one, so the tickets don't step on each other's working tree.
